description: Commission of Elections - Mr. Kirubairajah Naguleshwaran has vacated his office of member Trincomalee Town and Gravets P. S
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns a local government electoral process. It is a declaration by a Returning Officer that a member of a Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under the category of electoral matters, specifically related to the status of an elected official, as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
